integrity: Complete algebraic local-transition proof and two standalone check programs; no independent external mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Only deterministic synchronous one-step fixed configurations on labelled 3-by-n tori for n>=3; no higher temporal periods, noisy measures, or spatial-rotation quotient. 1997 ground-state primary full text was not available for full historical comparison.
title: Two coexisting fixed-state phases in the three-row Toom automaton
